title: Movens-Zero: Scaling Humanoid Motion Foundation Models with Large-Scale Human Videos

release_status.value: Official code, four checkpoint links and dataset entry points verified. Full data shards and model execution not independently checked.

evidence_boundaries: 15M human and 5M humanoid sequences are pipeline-stage counts.
Acceptance requires one successful evaluated simulation-controller rollout, not hardware validation.
Video conditioning uses visible human examples; it is not wearer-body reconstruction from egocentric clips.
The action expert produces explicit 40D G1 reference motion, not torques or a SONIC action latent.
50 Hz is the motion frame rate; a 20-frame commitment is 0.4 s. Hardware display offsets do not measure system latency.
Real G1 examples are qualitative; no aggregate hardware success rate or autonomous object-manipulation benchmark is reported.
Published data card has inconsistent shard-repository count; four linked repositories were verified but individual contents were not audited.
